title: White horse hills 5,300 m from the Avebury complex

tellings.quote: distance between the white horse hills of Wiltshire and there's several of them in the vicinity of the aberry stone circle complex is 5,300 m which is exactly 3.3 miles.

plain: In Wiltshire, England, several hills have giant white horses cut into their chalk, and the distance between them and the Avebury stone circles nearby is 5,300 metres, "exactly 3.3 miles." Geoffrey Drumm, who studies the pyramids and ancient sites, tells Michels this. If it holds, the old sites were placed by careful measurement rather than by chance.
